== Summary ==
Oversized slip, 6 February 2009: Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (7 side), as printed on the Players Committee's separate oversized objective sheet “Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed” (“Official text as of February 6, 2009”) for [[Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed]].

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/V17-Oversized.pdf V17-Oversized.pdf] (res.starwarsccg.org; Illustrator PDF dated 6 February 2009), page 1. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed) (Original)]].
